GodTier_Electro_Create_a_purple_lightnin.snippet:
-- Purple Lightning Custom Emitter
local host = Instance.new('Part')
host.Name = 'PurpleLightningHost'
host.Anchored = true
host.Parent = workspace

local emitter = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
emitter.Rate = 45
emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255))
emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20)
emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
emitter.Parent = host

-- Wait for the emitter to finish processing particles
host:WaitForChild('Emitter').WaitForChild('Particles').WaitForChild('Emit')

-- Debounce the emitter to prevent excessive particle emission
local function debouncedEmit()
    local task = host:WaitForChild('Emitter').WaitForChild('Particles').WaitForChild('Emit')
    task:Wait()
end

host:WaitForChild('Emitter').WaitForChild('Particles').WaitForChild('Emit').OnEvent = debouncedEmit

-- Optional: Add a cleanup function to remove the emitter when the host is destroyed
local function cleanup()
    host:Destroy()
end
host:Destroy = cleanup
